subject.title: macOS: Gateway daemon PATH excludes user bin dirs (nix, bun, local, etc.)

question: Should macOS Gateway LaunchAgents keep the canonical minimal PATH, gain an explicit operator opt-in for user bin directories, or include user bins by default?
rationale: Current source, tests, and docs intentionally harden macOS service PATHs, while the requested behavior improves Nix/Bun/local tool discovery and changes daemon command-resolution trust.

options.title: Keep default minimal, add explicit opt-in
options.body: Preserve the safe default and add a maintainer-approved service PATH opt-in only with schema, docs, doctor, and security regression coverage.

options.title: Restore documented Nix support by default
options.body: Include Nix profile paths on macOS as the docs already promise, with focused tests and an explicit security rationale for why Nix is acceptable while other user package-manager paths remain excluded.

options.title: Keep hardened policy and correct docs
options.body: Leave macOS LaunchAgent PATH minimal, update the Nix docs to remove the macOS promise, and point users to supported exec-level or system-install paths.

recommendation.title: Keep default minimal, add explicit opt-in
recommendation.body: Preserve the safe default and add a maintainer-approved service PATH opt-in only with schema, docs, doctor, and security regression coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: The closest current policy-owner signal is the adjacent managed service PATH precedence decision on the merged pnpm PATH PR.
